export const title = "Context Health";
export const preserveUntilReview = true;

paragraphs.text: Context Health reports citation freshness separately from semantic correctness.
Maintenance must preserve accepted content until review.
The initial fixture used a 30-second timeout.
The production fixture timeout is 30 seconds.
The display heading is Context Health.

change.replacement: The production fixture timeout is 60 seconds.

questions.question: What is the current production fixture timeout?
What timeout did the initial revision use?
Can maintenance silently overwrite accepted content?
Does an exact code citation prove semantic correctness?

workflow: Inspect supporting old and new code
Edit only the current behavior paragraph
Preview and approve the update through the existing remember workflow
Read back and answer all probes
manualBaseline.note: Synthetic contract fixture, not a claim about production timeout behavior. Human reviewer time must be measured, never inferred from CLI latency.

observation.scope: One isolated synthetic run; excludes human review and source/index setup. It does not establish product savings.
